DJI.note: Forum participant profiles; no rule or authority on AI harms.
Bouho AI only hopes to assist citizens in public services; no government body is stated to use AI.
HOOM is a private education app with no public body using it stated.

facts.fact: La Nation reports that HOOM, an AI-based education application conceived and developed by Djiboutians, is already used by more than 4,500 terminale pupils, about 57% of the year group, and includes the KékéBot teaching assistant.
